subject: Preventing Duplicate Emergency Check Ins during Satellite to Cellular Handover
title_ko: 위성에서 셀룰러 전환 중 비상 체크인 중복 방지
summary_ko: 가상의 Android 현장 대응 회의에서 위성 전송 중 셀룰러 연결이 복구될 때 비상 check-in이 중복 제출되는 문제를 분석한다. 팀들은 process restart를 넘어 유지되는 logical identifier, transferable lease, 명시적 취소 결과, 제한적 현장 억제책과 검증 게이트를 결정한다. 모든 인물·조직·단말·통신망·위성 서비스·모뎀·로그·결함·수치·일정은 Business English 교육을 위한 가상 설정이며 실제 기업이나 제품의 실제 결함을 주장하지 않는다.

turns.speaker: Grace Liu
turns.en: Emergency Messaging Framework, Modem Protocol and BSP, Field Reliability, and Carrier Integration and Validation are represented. We are reviewing duplicate emergency check-in messages reported after devices leave satellite-only coverage and regain cellular service. The sender sees one successful check-in, but selected recipients receive the same text twice, usually 20 to 70 seconds apart. We must determine which layer owns a queued message during transport handover, distinguish a delayed acknowledgment from a real resend, define a safe field containment, and agree on a permanent contract. Today's decision must preserve delivery reliability; dropping a legitimate emergency message is not an acceptable way to eliminate duplicates.
turns.ko: Emergency Messaging Framework, Modem Protocol and BSP, Field Reliability, Carrier Integration and Validation 팀이 참석했습니다. 단말이 위성 전용 커버리지를 벗어나 셀룰러 서비스를 회복한 뒤 비상 check-in 메시지가 중복되는 현장 보고를 검토합니다. 발신자는 성공한 check-in 하나를 보지만 일부 수신자는 동일 문자를 보통 20~70초 간격으로 두 번 받습니다. transport handover 중 queued message의 소유 계층을 정하고, 지연 acknowledgment와 실제 resend를 구분하며, 안전한 현장 억제책과 영구 계약에 합의해야 합니다. 오늘 결정은 전달 신뢰성을 보존해야 하며 정상 비상 메시지를 버리는 방식으로 중복을 없애는 것은 허용할 수 없습니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Park
turns.en: Framework creates one logical message and assigns a random 128-bit identifier before selecting a transport. When satellite is chosen, the framework gives the payload and identifier to the vendor service, starts a six-minute user-visible timer, and waits for a terminal receipt. In the reported traces, cellular becomes available while the satellite service still reports SENT_TO_LINK rather than DELIVERED. Framework then asks the cellular transport to send because its policy interprets SENT_TO_LINK as nonterminal. Later, the satellite acknowledgment arrives and both paths report success. The current policy protects against a lost satellite acknowledgment, but it can authorize two transports to own the same message at once.
turns.ko: Framework는 논리 메시지 하나를 만들고 transport를 선택하기 전에 무작위 128-bit identifier를 할당합니다. 위성이 선택되면 payload와 identifier를 vendor service에 넘기고 사용자에게 보이는 6분 timer를 시작한 뒤 terminal receipt를 기다립니다. 보고된 trace에서는 satellite service가 DELIVERED가 아니라 SENT_TO_LINK를 보고하는 동안 cellular가 사용 가능해집니다. Framework 정책은 SENT_TO_LINK를 nonterminal로 해석해 cellular transport에도 전송을 요청합니다. 이후 위성 acknowledgment가 도착하고 두 경로 모두 성공을 보고합니다. 현재 정책은 위성 acknowledgment 유실을 보호하지만 같은 메시지를 두 transport가 동시에 소유하도록 허용할 수 있습니다.

turns.speaker: Ravi Shah
turns.en: The modem does not resend the satellite frame after cellular registration. It submits one burst to the satellite link controller and keeps a local retry lease until the network receipt or a 180-second timeout. During cellular attach, the vendor service process restarts to switch protocol stacks. Its restored state contains payload hash and retry count, but not the framework's logical identifier because the persistence schema predates that field. The restored service therefore exposes the pending satellite transaction under a new local token. Framework sees no matching owner and begins cellular delivery. This is not simply a late acknowledgment; it is an identity break across process recovery.
turns.ko: Modem은 cellular registration 뒤 satellite frame을 다시 보내지 않습니다. satellite link controller에 burst 하나를 제출하고 network receipt 또는 180초 timeout까지 local retry lease를 유지합니다. cellular attach 중 protocol stack 전환을 위해 vendor service process가 restart됩니다. 복원 state에는 payload hash와 retry count가 있지만 persistence schema가 해당 field보다 오래돼 framework logical identifier는 없습니다. 따라서 복원된 service는 pending satellite transaction을 새 local token으로 노출합니다. Framework는 일치하는 owner를 찾지 못해 cellular delivery를 시작합니다. 이는 단순한 late acknowledgment가 아니라 process recovery를 넘는 identity break입니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.en: Carrier-side evidence confirms two distinct submissions. The satellite gateway accepted message sequence 481 at 09:14:22 and issued its receipt 43 seconds later. The cellular messaging center accepted a second submission with equivalent content at 09:14:39. Recipients on three networks received both, so downstream filtering cannot be assumed. Payload hashes are useful for investigation but unsafe for deduplication because two intentional check-ins may contain identical text. The stable key must represent user intent, not content. We also need to account for a gateway that accepts a message but never returns a receipt; ownership cannot remain frozen forever.
turns.ko: Carrier 측 증거는 서로 다른 submission 두 건을 확인합니다. satellite gateway는 09:14:22에 message sequence 481을 수락하고 43초 뒤 receipt를 발행했습니다. cellular messaging center는 09:14:39에 동일한 내용의 두 번째 submission을 수락했습니다. 세 network의 수신자가 둘 다 받았으므로 downstream filtering을 가정할 수 없습니다. payload hash는 조사에는 유용하지만 의도적으로 같은 text를 보낸 check-in 두 건을 구분하지 못해 deduplication에는 안전하지 않습니다. stable key는 content가 아니라 user intent를 나타내야 합니다. gateway가 message를 수락했지만 receipt를 반환하지 않는 경우도 고려해야 하며 ownership을 영원히 freeze할 수는 없습니다.

turns.speaker: Grace Liu
turns.en: We have 38 confirmed duplicate incidents among 62,000 satellite check-ins over six weeks. Thirty-four followed a vendor service restart within one minute of cellular recovery. Four had no visible restart but did show a binder death and reconnect. We found no duplicates when coverage stayed satellite-only or cellular-only. All original messages arrived; the customer harm is confusion and repeated escalation, not loss. Field Reliability recommends disabling automatic cellular promotion for any message that reached SENT_TO_LINK until the full six-minute timer expires. That is simple and remotely configurable, although it may delay rescue coordination when the satellite path actually failed.
turns.ko: 6주간 satellite check-in 62,000건 중 확인된 중복 incident는 38건입니다. 34건은 cellular 회복 1분 이내 vendor service restart 뒤 발생했습니다. 4건은 눈에 보이는 restart는 없었지만 binder death와 reconnect가 있었습니다. coverage가 satellite-only 또는 cellular-only로 유지된 경우 중복은 없었습니다. original message는 모두 도착했으며 고객 피해는 유실이 아니라 혼란과 반복 escalation입니다. Field Reliability는 SENT_TO_LINK에 도달한 message는 6분 timer가 끝날 때까지 automatic cellular promotion을 비활성화할 것을 권고합니다. 단순하고 원격 설정 가능하지만 satellite path가 실제 실패했을 때 구조 조정을 지연시킬 수 있습니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Park
turns.en: I do not support a blanket six-minute hold. The user may have walked under tree cover, the satellite burst may never have left the device, and cellular could become the only reliable path. Framework needs a transferable lease with explicit states: RESERVED, SUBMITTED, NETWORK_ACCEPTED, DELIVERED, FAILED, and EXPIRED. A transport holding SUBMITTED ownership must either return the same logical identifier after restart or declare its lease unrecoverable. Cellular promotion can occur only after the previous lease is released or expires. For urgent delivery, Framework may request cancellation, but cancellation must have a definitive outcome rather than a best-effort call followed immediately by resend.
turns.ko: 일괄적인 6분 hold에는 동의하지 않습니다. 사용자가 나무 아래로 이동해 satellite burst가 단말을 떠나지 못했을 수 있고 cellular가 유일하게 신뢰할 수 있는 path가 될 수 있습니다. Framework에는 RESERVED, SUBMITTED, NETWORK_ACCEPTED, DELIVERED, FAILED, EXPIRED 명시 state를 가진 transferable lease가 필요합니다. SUBMITTED ownership을 가진 transport는 restart 뒤 같은 logical identifier를 반환하거나 lease가 복구 불가능하다고 선언해야 합니다. cellular promotion은 이전 lease가 release되거나 expire된 뒤에만 가능합니다. 긴급 전달을 위해 Framework가 cancellation을 요청할 수 있지만 cancellation은 best-effort call 뒤 즉시 resend하는 방식이 아니라 확정 outcome을 가져야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Ravi Shah
turns.en: The proposed states are sound, but NETWORK_ACCEPTED is not always observable on the satellite controller. We receive a link-layer acknowledgment that proves the burst reached the gateway radio, while the end-to-end receipt can be delayed or absent. Calling that state NETWORK_ACCEPTED would overstate the evidence. I suggest LINK_ACKNOWLEDGED plus a receipt confidence field. More importantly, cancellation after a link acknowledgment cannot guarantee withdrawal. The modem can stop local retries, but the gateway may already be forwarding the message. The contract should say CANCELLATION_REQUESTED and CANCELLATION_CONFIRMED separately. Until confirmation, another transport must not send unless the user explicitly chooses an emergency override.
turns.ko: 제안된 state는 타당하지만 satellite controller에서 NETWORK_ACCEPTED를 항상 관찰할 수는 없습니다. burst가 gateway radio에 도달했음을 증명하는 link-layer acknowledgment는 받지만 end-to-end receipt는 지연되거나 없을 수 있습니다. 이를 NETWORK_ACCEPTED라 부르면 증거를 과장합니다. LINK_ACKNOWLEDGED와 receipt confidence field를 제안합니다. 더 중요한 점은 link acknowledgment 뒤 cancellation이 철회를 보장할 수 없다는 것입니다. modem은 local retry를 멈출 수 있지만 gateway는 이미 message를 forwarding 중일 수 있습니다. 계약은 CANCELLATION_REQUESTED와 CANCELLATION_CONFIRMED를 분리해야 합니다. confirmation 전에는 사용자가 emergency override를 명시적으로 선택하지 않는 한 다른 transport가 전송하면 안 됩니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.en: Carrier Integration agrees on the semantic distinction. We can add a terminal recipient receipt only on participating test networks, so the product contract cannot depend on it. The common evidence is transport submission, link acknowledgment, gateway receipt when available, and final timeout. For the emergency override, the interface must warn that a duplicate is possible and preserve the same logical identifier in both submissions. Partner gateways will receive that identifier in an opaque extension; networks that support deduplication may suppress a duplicate, while unsupported networks ignore it. Device correctness cannot rely on partner suppression, but carrying the identifier gives us independent evidence and a future interoperability path.
turns.ko: Carrier Integration은 의미 구분에 동의합니다. terminal recipient receipt는 참여 test network에만 추가할 수 있어 product contract가 이에 의존하면 안 됩니다. 공통 증거는 transport submission, link acknowledgment, 가능한 경우 gateway receipt, final timeout입니다. emergency override의 interface는 중복 가능성을 경고하고 두 submission에 같은 logical identifier를 보존해야 합니다. partner gateway는 opaque extension으로 identifier를 받으며 deduplication을 지원하는 network는 중복을 억제할 수 있고 미지원 network는 무시합니다. 단말 correctness가 partner suppression에 의존할 수는 없지만 identifier 전달은 독립 증거와 향후 interoperability path를 제공합니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Park
turns.en: The framework contract will maintain one message record with logical identifier, intent timestamp, active transport, lease generation, state, last evidence, and expiry. A process reconnect presents all active leases before it can accept new work. Framework matches identifier and generation, not local token or payload hash. If the service cannot restore an identifier, it reports ORPHANED_SUBMISSION with the strongest evidence it has. Framework then holds promotion until the risk window expires, asks the user for an informed override, or receives cancellation confirmation. This makes ambiguity explicit instead of silently creating a second owner.
turns.ko: Framework 계약은 logical identifier, intent timestamp, active transport, lease generation, state, last evidence, expiry를 가진 message record 하나를 유지합니다. process reconnect는 새 work를 받기 전에 모든 active lease를 제시합니다. Framework는 local token이나 payload hash가 아니라 identifier와 generation을 match합니다. service가 identifier를 복원할 수 없으면 가진 가장 강한 증거와 함께 ORPHANED_SUBMISSION을 보고합니다. Framework는 risk window가 만료되거나 informed override를 사용자에게 받거나 cancellation confirmation을 받을 때까지 promotion을 hold합니다. 이렇게 하면 조용히 두 번째 owner를 만드는 대신 ambiguity를 명시합니다.

turns.speaker: Ravi Shah
turns.en: BSP will migrate the persistence schema atomically. Each record contains logical identifier, lease generation, controller transaction, submission state, retry deadline, and checksum. We write the new slot, flush it, then switch a generation pointer; a power loss cannot expose a half-migrated lease. On first boot with old records, the service marks them legacy orphaned and refuses automatic promotion for their remaining retry window. The modem never fabricates a terminal receipt. After restart it replays exactly one current-state callback per lease, followed by incremental changes. Framework acknowledgments are idempotent so a callback replay cannot create a new controller submission.
turns.ko: BSP는 persistence schema를 atomic하게 migrate합니다. 각 record는 logical identifier, lease generation, controller transaction, submission state, retry deadline, checksum을 포함합니다. 새 slot을 쓰고 flush한 뒤 generation pointer를 전환하므로 power loss가 반만 migrate된 lease를 노출할 수 없습니다. 구형 record가 있는 첫 boot에서 service는 이를 legacy orphaned로 표시하고 남은 retry window 동안 automatic promotion을 거부합니다. modem은 terminal receipt를 만들어내지 않습니다. restart 뒤 lease별 current-state callback 하나만 replay하고 이후 incremental change를 보냅니다. Framework acknowledgment는 idempotent하므로 callback replay가 새 controller submission을 만들 수 없습니다.

turns.speaker: Grace Liu
turns.en: For immediate containment, we can target only builds with the old persistence schema. When a satellite message reaches SENT_TO_LINK and cellular returns within 90 seconds, automatic promotion pauses for 75 seconds while the service reconnects and reconciles leases. If reconciliation proves no submission, cellular sends immediately. If the lease is orphaned, the UI offers an override with duplicate risk after 30 seconds. The flag does not change satellite retry behavior and expires after the fixed build reaches 95 percent adoption. We will monitor delivery time, overrides, duplicates, timeouts, service restarts, and abandoned messages by build and region.
turns.ko: 즉시 억제책은 구형 persistence schema build에만 적용할 수 있습니다. satellite message가 SENT_TO_LINK에 도달하고 90초 안에 cellular가 돌아오면 service가 reconnect하고 lease를 reconcile하는 동안 automatic promotion을 75초 pause합니다. reconciliation이 submission 없음으로 입증하면 cellular가 즉시 보냅니다. lease가 orphaned이면 UI는 30초 뒤 duplicate risk와 함께 override를 제공합니다. flag는 satellite retry behavior를 바꾸지 않고 fixed build가 95% adoption에 도달하면 만료됩니다. build와 region별로 delivery time, override, duplicate, timeout, service restart, abandoned message를 monitor합니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.en: Validation will run five cells: satellite success with delayed receipt, satellite loss before link acknowledgment, gateway acceptance without receipt, service death during persistence, and cellular recovery during every lease state. We will add power cuts before and after pointer switch, repeated binder reconnects, airplane-mode toggles, roaming registration, dual-SIM data switching, and clock changes. Each logical message gets a test oracle independent of device logs. The gates are zero unintended dual submission in 50,000 transitions, zero lost messages, correct state restoration in every power cut, p99 handover delay below 85 seconds without override, and no more than one user prompt per logical message.
turns.ko: Validation은 delayed receipt가 있는 satellite success, link acknowledgment 전 satellite loss, receipt 없는 gateway acceptance, persistence 중 service death, 모든 lease state에서 cellular recovery 다섯 cell을 실행합니다. pointer switch 전후 power cut, 반복 binder reconnect, airplane-mode toggle, roaming registration, dual-SIM data switching, clock change를 추가합니다. 각 logical message는 device log와 독립적인 test oracle을 가집니다. 게이트는 50,000 transition에서 의도치 않은 dual submission 0건, lost message 0건, 모든 power cut에서 올바른 state restoration, override 없이 handover delay p99 85초 미만, logical message당 user prompt 1회 이하입니다.

turns.speaker: Grace Liu
turns.en: The decision is to ship the scoped containment flag while implementing the persistent transferable lease. We will not depend on payload hashes, recipient-side filtering, or a blanket six-minute delay. Field Reliability owns incident correlation, flag targeting, dashboard thresholds, and rollback criteria. The containment configuration is due today at 12:00 KST and begins at 5 percent of affected builds at 15:00. We advance to 25 percent after six hours only if duplicate rate falls, p95 delivery delay stays below 70 seconds, and abandoned-message count remains zero. Any lost message, repeated prompt, or regional anomaly stops expansion.
turns.ko: 결정은 persistent transferable lease를 구현하는 동안 범위가 제한된 containment flag를 배포하는 것입니다. payload hash, recipient-side filtering, 일괄 6분 delay에 의존하지 않습니다. Field Reliability는 incident correlation, flag targeting, dashboard threshold, rollback criteria를 담당합니다. containment configuration은 오늘 정오 KST까지이며 영향 build의 5%에 오후 3시 시작합니다. duplicate rate가 감소하고 delivery delay p95가 70초 미만이며 abandoned-message count가 0일 때만 6시간 뒤 25%로 진행합니다. lost message, repeated prompt, regional anomaly 중 하나라도 있으면 확대를 중단합니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Park
turns.en: I own the framework lease state machine, reconnect reconciliation, informed override, idempotent callbacks, and metrics. The interface specification is due November 6 at 11:00 KST, the reviewed patch November 8 at 16:00, and the integrated image November 9 at 14:00. My tests cover two rapid user check-ins with identical text, cancellation races, service reconnect before registration, framework restart, and a stale callback from an older generation. Stop conditions are concurrent active owners without explicit override, a local token used as identity, or any transition that loses the original user intent record.
turns.ko: framework lease state machine, reconnect reconciliation, informed override, idempotent callback, metric은 제가 담당합니다. interface specification은 11월 6일 오전 11시 KST, reviewed patch는 11월 8일 오후 4시, integrated image는 11월 9일 오후 2시까지입니다. 시험은 동일 text의 빠른 user check-in 두 건, cancellation race, registration 전 service reconnect, framework restart, 이전 generation의 stale callback을 다룹니다. 명시적 override 없이 concurrent active owner가 생기거나 local token을 identity로 사용하거나 original user intent record를 잃는 transition이 중단 조건입니다.

turns.speaker: Ravi Shah
turns.en: I own schema migration, durable lease restoration, controller cancellation outcomes, callback replay, and modem trace fields. The persistence prototype is due November 6 at 18:00 KST, and BSP integration November 8 at noon. We will test migration from the last three production schemas and downgrade back to each supported build. A downgrade may mark a lease unreadable, but it cannot resend it automatically. I will publish a state-transition table that maps every controller result to the contract without strengthening weak evidence. Stop conditions include checksum acceptance after corruption, two controller transactions for one generation, or a replay that increments retry count.
turns.ko: schema migration, durable lease restoration, controller cancellation outcome, callback replay, modem trace field는 제가 담당합니다. persistence prototype은 11월 6일 오후 6시 KST, BSP integration은 11월 8일 정오까지입니다. 최근 production schema 세 개에서 migration하고 지원되는 각 build로 downgrade하는 시험을 수행합니다. downgrade가 lease를 unreadable로 표시할 수는 있지만 자동 resend해서는 안 됩니다. 약한 증거를 강하게 표현하지 않으면서 모든 controller result를 계약에 mapping한 state-transition table을 게시합니다. 손상 뒤 checksum 수락, generation 하나에 controller transaction 두 개, retry count를 증가시키는 replay가 중단 조건입니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.en: I own the gateway simulator, partner extension tests, power-cut matrix, end-to-end oracle, and certification report. Simulator updates are due November 7 at 10:00 KST, full execution starts with the integrated image, and results are due November 11 at noon. We will include unsupported gateways that ignore the logical identifier and participating gateways that deduplicate it, but the primary pass criteria use the unsupported path. Test exclusions require a documented laboratory hardware fault before logs are opened. Slow receipts and inconvenient networks remain in the denominator. I will publish the worst twenty traces as well as aggregate success rates.
turns.ko: gateway simulator, partner extension test, power-cut matrix, end-to-end oracle, certification report는 제가 담당합니다. simulator update는 11월 7일 오전 10시 KST, full execution은 integrated image와 함께 시작하며 결과는 11월 11일 정오까지입니다. logical identifier를 무시하는 unsupported gateway와 이를 deduplicate하는 participating gateway를 포함하지만 primary pass criteria는 unsupported path를 사용합니다. test exclusion은 log를 열기 전에 문서화된 laboratory hardware fault가 필요합니다. 느린 receipt와 불편한 network도 denominator에 남습니다. aggregate success rate와 함께 최악 trace 20개를 게시합니다.

turns.speaker: Elena Park
turns.en: One residual risk is user confusion during emergency override. The prompt must explain that the first path may still deliver, offer wait or send-now choices, and remain accessible without requiring network data. It must not imply guaranteed cancellation. If the user sends now, Framework records explicit dual ownership under the same identifier and suppresses further automatic promotion. A device restart must restore the choice and cannot show the prompt again. We will test screen reader focus, large text, glove interaction, low battery, locked state, and language fallback. The override is an exception with a visible audit trail, not a hidden shortcut around the lease contract.
turns.ko: 잔여 위험 하나는 emergency override 중 사용자 혼란입니다. prompt는 첫 path가 여전히 deliver될 수 있음을 설명하고 wait 또는 send-now 선택을 제공하며 network data 없이도 접근 가능해야 합니다. guaranteed cancellation을 암시하면 안 됩니다. 사용자가 send now를 선택하면 Framework는 같은 identifier 아래 explicit dual ownership을 기록하고 이후 automatic promotion을 억제합니다. device restart는 선택을 복원하고 prompt를 다시 보여서는 안 됩니다. screen reader focus, large text, glove interaction, low battery, locked state, language fallback을 시험합니다. override는 lease contract를 우회하는 숨은 shortcut이 아니라 visible audit trail이 있는 예외입니다.

turns.speaker: Ravi Shah
turns.en: Another risk is controller firmware that reports a link acknowledgment before durable storage completes. A sudden reset could restore the lease as SUBMITTED even though the gateway may already have the burst. We will change ordering so the controller transaction and logical identifier are committed before transmission is enabled, then commit LINK_ACKNOWLEDGED after the acknowledgment. If the second commit fails, restoration reports AMBIGUOUS_AFTER_LINK rather than SUBMITTED. That state prohibits automatic resend and starts the override risk window. We will inject resets at every instruction boundary around both commits and compare the controller's independent transmission counter with restored state.
turns.ko: 또 다른 위험은 durable storage 완료 전에 link acknowledgment를 보고하는 controller firmware입니다. 갑작스러운 reset은 gateway가 이미 burst를 가졌는데도 lease를 SUBMITTED로 복원할 수 있습니다. transmission을 enable하기 전에 controller transaction과 logical identifier를 commit하고 acknowledgment 뒤 LINK_ACKNOWLEDGED를 commit하도록 순서를 변경합니다. 두 번째 commit이 실패하면 restoration은 SUBMITTED가 아니라 AMBIGUOUS_AFTER_LINK를 보고합니다. 이 state는 automatic resend를 금지하고 override risk window를 시작합니다. 두 commit 주변의 모든 instruction boundary에서 reset을 주입하고 controller independent transmission counter와 restored state를 비교합니다.

turns.speaker: Grace Liu
turns.en: Operationally, support teams need one incident view without exposing message content. The dashboard will show logical identifier hash scoped to the case, build, region, lease states, transport evidence, restart generation, timing buckets, override choice, and final receipts. Free-form payload and recipient address are excluded. A duplicate is confirmed only when independent gateway records show two submissions for one logical identifier; repeated customer reports alone remain suspected. This definition prevents inflated counts and gives engineering a consistent denominator. We will retain case telemetry for 30 days, restrict access to the response group, and remove the containment dashboard after the rollout closes.
turns.ko: 운영 측면에서 support team은 message content를 노출하지 않는 하나의 incident view가 필요합니다. dashboard는 case에 한정된 logical identifier hash, build, region, lease state, transport evidence, restart generation, timing bucket, override choice, final receipt를 보여줍니다. free-form payload와 recipient address는 제외합니다. 독립 gateway record가 logical identifier 하나에 submission 두 건을 보여줄 때만 duplicate를 confirm하며 반복 customer report만 있으면 suspected로 남깁니다. 이 정의는 count 부풀림을 막고 engineering에 일관된 denominator를 제공합니다. case telemetry는 30일 보존하고 response group에 접근을 제한하며 rollout 종료 뒤 containment dashboard를 제거합니다.

turns.speaker: Grace Liu
turns.en: We must also guard against a containment flag that outlives its evidence. The configuration service will carry an owner, affected build range, activation timestamp, expiry timestamp, success metric, and automatic rollback threshold. Devices outside the declared schema versions ignore the flag. Every twelve hours, Field Reliability will compare duplicate incidence with a matched unaffected cohort and publish confidence intervals rather than raw percentages alone. If duplicate reports fall but delivery abandonment or override use rises, we will treat the containment as harmful. The flag expires after ten days unless the incident commander records a new evidence review; routine operational convenience is not sufficient justification for extension.
turns.ko: containment flag가 근거보다 오래 유지되지 않도록 보호해야 합니다. configuration service는 owner, affected build range, activation timestamp, expiry timestamp, success metric, automatic rollback threshold를 포함합니다. 선언된 schema version 밖의 단말은 flag를 무시합니다. Field Reliability는 12시간마다 duplicate incidence를 matched unaffected cohort와 비교하고 raw percentage만이 아니라 confidence interval을 게시합니다. duplicate report가 줄어도 delivery abandonment 또는 override 사용이 늘면 containment를 해로운 것으로 판단합니다. incident commander가 새 evidence review를 기록하지 않으면 flag는 10일 뒤 만료되며 일상 운영의 편리함은 연장 근거로 충분하지 않습니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.en: Certification will include a blinded reconciliation exercise. One operator configures the gateway outcome and service failure, while another receives only device state callbacks, controller counters, and gateway receipts. The second operator must determine whether promotion is safe, unsafe, or ambiguous and cite the evidence for that classification. Cases include a duplicated callback with no second transmission, two transmissions with one missing receipt, cancellation confirmed after timeout, and a legitimate pair of identical user messages. A correct design must preserve uncertainty instead of forcing every case into success or failure. We will score false certainty separately because a confident but unsupported promotion decision is exactly how the present duplicate escaped review.
turns.ko: Certification은 blinded reconciliation exercise를 포함합니다. 한 operator가 gateway outcome과 service failure를 설정하고 다른 operator는 device state callback, controller counter, gateway receipt만 받습니다. 두 번째 operator는 promotion이 safe, unsafe, ambiguous 중 무엇인지 판단하고 그 classification의 증거를 제시해야 합니다. 두 번째 transmission 없는 duplicated callback, receipt 하나가 누락된 transmission 두 건, timeout 뒤 확인된 cancellation, 동일한 legitimate user message 두 건을 포함합니다. 올바른 설계는 모든 사례를 success나 failure로 강제하지 않고 uncertainty를 보존해야 합니다. 현재 중복이 review를 통과한 원인이 자신감은 있지만 근거 없는 promotion decision이므로 false certainty를 별도로 평가합니다.

turns.speaker: Owen Brooks
turns.en: The follow-up meeting is Wednesday, November 11, at 16:00 KST. We will review containment field metrics, lease restoration, cancellation semantics, migration and downgrade, accessibility, gateway interoperability, power-cut results, and all 50,000 transitions. Progression requires approval from all four teams. Any lost message, unintended dual submission, repeated override prompt, fabricated receipt, or state mismatch keeps the gate closed and triggers a corrected full-matrix rerun. Passing authorizes a 500-device employee pilot for seven days, not public rollout. I will distribute today's decision record and test identifiers by 18:00 KST, and owners will confirm dependencies by tomorrow noon.
turns.ko: 후속 회의는 11월 11일 수요일 오후 4시 KST입니다. containment field metric, lease restoration, cancellation semantic, migration과 downgrade, accessibility, gateway interoperability, power-cut result, 50,000 transition 전체를 검토합니다. 진행에는 네 팀 모두의 승인이 필요합니다. lost message, unintended dual submission, repeated override prompt, fabricated receipt, state mismatch 중 하나라도 있으면 게이트를 닫아 두고 수정된 full-matrix rerun을 수행합니다. 통과는 7일간 employee device 500대 pilot만 승인하며 public rollout이 아닙니다. 오늘 오후 6시 KST까지 decision record와 test identifier를 배포하고 담당자는 내일 정오까지 dependency를 확인합니다.

expressions.usage_ko: 안전 목표를 유지해야 함을 강조할 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: Today's decision must preserve delivery reliability; dropping a legitimate emergency message is not an acceptable way to eliminate duplicates.
expressions.practice: The fallback must preserve delivery reliability during a controller restart.

expressions.phrase: own the same message at once
expressions.usage_ko: 중복 소유권 문제를 설명할 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: The current policy protects against a lost satellite acknowledgment, but it can authorize two transports to own the same message at once.
expressions.practice: Two workers must not own the same message at once.

expressions.usage_ko: 재시작 전후 추적이 끊긴 원인을 말할 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: This is not simply a late acknowledgment; it is an identity break across process recovery.
expressions.practice: The new trace confirms an identity break across service recovery.

expressions.usage_ko: 콘텐츠가 아닌 논리 요청을 식별할 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: The stable key must represent user intent, not content.
expressions.practice: A durable request ID should represent user intent rather than payload content.

expressions.usage_ko: 모든 경우에 적용되는 단순 지연책을 비판할 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: I do not support a blanket six-minute hold.
expressions.practice: We rejected a blanket six-minute hold because failures have different evidence.

expressions.usage_ko: 취소나 작업 상태가 모호하지 않아야 할 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: For urgent delivery, Framework may request cancellation, but cancellation must have a definitive outcome rather than a best-effort call followed immediately by resend.
expressions.practice: The cancellation API needs a definitive outcome before failover.

expressions.usage_ko: 관찰보다 강한 상태명을 경계할 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: Calling that state NETWORK_ACCEPTED would overstate the evidence.
expressions.practice: Do not overstate the evidence when only a link receipt exists.

expressions.usage_ko: 파트너 확장 가능성을 말할 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: Device correctness cannot rely on partner suppression, but carrying the identifier gives us independent evidence and a future interoperability path.
expressions.practice: The optional field creates a future interoperability path.

expressions.usage_ko: 명시적 상태 없이 중복 작업이 생김을 경계할 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: This makes ambiguity explicit instead of silently creating a second owner.
expressions.practice: Explicit ambiguity is safer than silently creating a second owner.

expressions.usage_ko: 반복 호출이 추가 효과를 만들지 않을 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: Framework acknowledgments are idempotent so a callback replay cannot create a new controller submission.
expressions.practice: The replay callback is idempotent across repeated reconnects.

expressions.usage_ko: 검증 oracle의 독립성을 강조할 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: Each logical message gets a test oracle independent of device logs.
expressions.practice: The test oracle is independent of device logs and framework metrics.

expressions.usage_ko: 영향 대상을 좁힌 임시 조치를 말할 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: The decision is to ship the scoped containment flag while implementing the persistent transferable lease.
expressions.practice: A scoped containment flag limits risk while the durable fix is validated.

expressions.usage_ko: 불리한 사례도 통계에서 제외하지 않을 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: Slow receipts and inconvenient networks remain in the denominator.
expressions.practice: Slow partner networks remain in the denominator for the release decision.

expressions.usage_ko: 예외 선택이 추적 가능해야 할 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: The override is an exception with a visible audit trail, not a hidden shortcut around the lease contract.
expressions.practice: Every emergency override leaves a visible audit trail.

expressions.usage_ko: 필수 조건 미충족 시 진행을 막을 때 쓴다.
expressions.example: Any lost message, unintended dual submission, repeated override prompt, fabricated receipt, or state mismatch keeps the gate closed and triggers a corrected full-matrix rerun.
expressions.practice: Any message loss keeps the gate closed regardless of duplicate rate.
